name: @pipeworx/mcp-france-dvf

tools.name: fr_property_sales
tools.description: List recorded French property-transfer prices (DVF -- Demandes de valeurs foncieres, published by DGFiP) for a commune or postcode, optionally filtered by date range and property type. Each result is one recorded disposition (a specific parcel/lot in a transaction) with price, address-level commune, parcel id, property type, built surface, land surface, room count and coordinates. Pass commune as either a 5-digit INSEE code (e.g. "75111" for Paris 11e) or a commune name (e.g. "Lyon" matches all 9 Lyon arrondissements; "Paris 11e Arrondissement"). Use for "property sales in Paris 11e in 2025" or "recent house sales in Annecy". Covers a rolling five years; excludes Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte (see data_as_of/coverage_note in the response).

commune.description: 5-digit INSEE commune code (e.g. "75111") or a commune name (case-insensitive prefix match, e.g. "Lyon").

type.description: Property type: "Maison" (house), "Appartement" (apartment), "Dépendance" (outbuilding), or "Local industriel. commercial ou assimilé" (commercial/industrial).

tools.name: fr_property_sale
tools.description: One French property transaction ("mutation") by its DVF id_mutation, as returned by fr_property_sales. Returns every lot/parcel recorded under that transaction (a sale can bundle several parcels, e.g. a house plus a garage) with the shared transaction price, date and nature. Use after fr_property_sales to see the full set of parcels in a specific sale.

id.description: The id_mutation from a fr_property_sales result, e.g. "2025-123456".

tools.name: fr_property_stats
tools.description: Median and average price per square meter for a French commune and year, broken out by property type (Maison/Appartement), plus the total number of transactions. Computed only from single-lot sales (one parcel per transaction) with a positive built surface, because the DVF price field is the total for the whole transaction and would otherwise be double-counted or misattributed across bundled lots. Pass commune as a 5-digit INSEE code or a commune name; a name matching more than one commune (e.g. "Saint-Martin") returns the list of candidates instead of a number. Use for "median price per m2 in Lyon in 2024" or "how much do apartments go for in Nantes".

commune.description: 5-digit INSEE commune code (e.g. "69381" for Lyon 1er) or a commune name (e.g. "Lyon 1er Arrondissement", "Nantes"). A bare multi-arrondissement city name like "Lyon" or "Paris" returns all its arrondissements as candidates -- pass one commune.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-france-dvf forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the france-dvf pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
